regime_context: Policy intent is yield suppression without easing optics: Treasury engineering holds front-end rates down while Warsh keeps a hawkish inflation-first posture through a midterm-gated optionality window. Consensus reads the hawkish tape as genuine; revealed interest is inflation-credibility as a precondition for a later pivot, which makes the 'hike-majority + oil shock' split transiently vulnerable and keeps long-duration trades low-confidence.
regime_context_zh: 政策意图是在不释放宽松信号的情况下压低收益率：财政部通过发债结构设计压低前端利率，而沃什在中期选举前的期权窗口内维持鹰派、通胀优先的姿态。市场共识把鹰派表态当真；但实际利益是以通胀信誉作为日后转向的前提，这使得“加息概率占优+石油冲击”的分裂态势暂时脆弱，并使长久期交易保持低置信度。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes are a realized upside oil shock that re-primes energy inflows already evident in Q1 2026 ETF rotation. The administration tolerates near-term oil strength to fund its strong-dollar/front-end-easing bridge, so XLE relative to SPY benefits while escalation headlines persist.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂与美军打击已是兑现的油价上行冲击，重新点燃了2026年一季度ETF资金已明显流入能源板块的轮动。政府容忍短期油价走强来支撑其强美元/前端宽松的桥梁，因此只要升级新闻持续，XLE相对SPY受益。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: FACT ceasefire collapse, ~$80 Brent intraday 7/8, energy top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Market regime: Reflation quad, energy re-primed by escalation
theses.dissent: A sudden real ceasefire or Hormuz de-escalation would unwind the geopolitical premium fast, while peak-oil headlines could reverse the inflow before the check date.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果突然出现真正的停火或霍尔木兹局势降级，地缘溢价会快速消退，而峰值石油的言论可能在检查日之前逆转资金流入。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date despite no new US-Iran de-escalation.
falsifier.text_zh: 在美伊没有出现新的降级的情况下，XLE在检查日之前落后SPY达5%或更多。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh has held the hawkish line even after weak payrolls, and CME FedWatch moved to >70% September hike probability. Long-duration Treasuries face both a hawkish Fed and an oil-shock inflation impulse, making TLT structurally disadvantaged versus SPY until a labor-crack-driven September pivot actually materializes.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什即使在就业数据疲弱后仍坚持鹰派立场，CME FedWatch显示9月加息概率超过70%。长久期国债同时面临鹰派美联储与油价冲击带来的通胀压力，使得TLT在9月因就业恶化而真正转向之前，相对SPY处于结构性劣势。
evidence: Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
May PCE hot (core 3.4% y/y) + Iran oil spike = inflation impulse
theses.dissent: Treasury yield suppression via bill-heavy issuance and buybacks could crush long-end yields mechanically, and a widening labor crack could force a faster Fed pivot than priced.
theses.dissent_zh: 财政部通过偏重短债发行和回购进行的收益率压制可能机械性压低长端利率，而就业裂口扩大可能迫使美联储比市场定价更快转向。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 4% before the check-by date with Fed funds pricing staying at or above current level.
falsifier.text_zh: 在联邦基金利率定价维持在当前水平或更高的情况下，TLT在检查日之前跑赢SPY达4%。

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: NATO structural spending super-cycle is a targeted high-confidence fiscal mechanism independent of Fed policy. Defense primes and missile-defense proxies benefit from budget commitments that survive both the Iran re-escalation and domestic political cycles.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约结构性支出超级周期是一个独立于美联储政策的高置信度财政机制。国防主承包商与导弹防御相关标的受益于在伊朗再升级和国内政治周期中都能存续的预算承诺。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: FACT budget mechanism
Rotation targeted: Defense/shipbuilding/missile defense proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD
Defense bid persists regardless of oil path
theses.dissent: Recent track record shows ITA and XAR both missed in Q3 2026, suggesting either crowded positioning or execution lag versus the fiscal narrative, and a Russia-Ukraine/NATO funding compromise could stall the super-cycle.
theses.dissent_zh: 近期记录显示ITA和XAR在2026年三季度均未命中，表明要么持仓拥挤，要么财政叙事与实际执行之间存在滞后，而且俄乌或北约资金妥协可能使超级周期停滞。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date despite no reduction in NATO or US defense budget commitments.
falsifier.text_zh: 在北约或美国国防预算承诺没有缩减的情况下，ITA在检查日之前落后SPY达5%。

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: Treasury's dealer-intermediation reform and central-clearing expansion structurally favor dealer banks by reducing balance-sheet frictions and increasing Treasury market volume. The low-real-yield regime and steep front-end curve support bank net interest margins relative to broad equity.
theses.thesis_zh: 财政部的交易商中介改革与中央清算扩展通过降低资产负债表摩擦并提高国债市场交易量，对交易商银行形成结构性利好。低实际利率体制与陡峭的前端曲线支撑银行净息差，相对大盘股有利。
evidence: Open prediction: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion
Rotation targeted: Financials / dealer banks XLF, KBE
theses.dissent: A hawkish Fed that actually hikes into a growth slowdown could steepen credit losses and invert risk appetite, hitting banks harder than SPY; the Fed's MBS-to-T-bill reinvestment may also compress bank asset yields.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果美联储真在增长放缓时加息，可能加剧信贷损失并打压风险偏好，对银行的打击超过SPY；美联储将MBS到期再投资转向短债也可能压缩银行资产收益率。

falsifier.text: XLF lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date even as Treasury central-clearing or eSLR reform progresses on schedule.
falsifier.text_zh: 即使在国债中央清算或eSLR改革按计划推进的情况下，XLF在检查日之前落后SPY达5%。
